key_decisions: U3 surfaces deploy to the same vendor's free-tier managed runtime as B1; no new infrastructure is introduced (Q1=A)
Order hot path is a single synchronous DB transaction (NFR1.4); the 3 s p95 budget is met by the same envelope that B1 uses (Q2=A)
Paste-parse path is a pure function on the client; no I/O during parse; the 200-item cap is enforced inside the function (Q3=A)
Status-bucket math is in-process; per-page on 50 orders; typed state container is the cache (Q4=A)
Deferred input mode placeholders are typed placeholders only; the deferred_input_invoked log event is the impact-signal for a future Bolt (Q5=A)
Order mutation observability inherits B1's surface unchanged; the audit-log row IS the log line; vendor's free-tier slow-query dashboard covers the Order/OrderItem insert path (Q6=A)
B2 R2.x gates are added to the same CI pipeline; no new CI infrastructure (Q7=A)
postgres.js connection pool (max: 5) is shared across U1 + U2-U5 via typed function-calls; the audit_log table is the shared cross-unit resource (inherited from B1)
U3 adds Order + OrderItem + consignment_link tables to the same managed-DB; the app_role has CRUD on these; INSERT-only on audit_log (R1.1)
No new infrastructure services (no Redis, no message broker, no CDN, no LB, no WAF, no Vault, no IaC) — free-tier envelope is the binding constraint
Order/OrderItem INSERT success rate (≥ 99 % over 24 h) and INSERT p95 (≤ 200 ms) are the new SLIs added in B2
Audit-log row IS the log line (inherited from B1); no separate metric for order mutations
stdout (JSON line) is the secondary log surface for non-state-mutating events; queryable by event and level; deferred_input_invoked is emitted by the 3 deferred placeholders (NFR3.3)
No Prometheus / StatsD / OpenTelemetry / Jaeger on the free-tier envelope (inherited from B1)

SLI set: Order/OrderItem INSERT success rate (≥ 99 %), Order/OrderItem INSERT p95 (≤ 200 ms), parseMessage p95 (≤ 20 ms for ≤ 200 items, NFR6.7.1), status-bucket re-compute p95 (≤ 1 ms for ≤ 1 000 orders, NFR2.5), 3G order hot path p95 (≤ 3 s, NFR1.4)
5 new R2.x alerts (R2.1 audit append, R2.2 parseMessage segments, R2.3 status-bucket, R2.4 status exhaustive, R2.5 deferred-input logging) added to the inherited alert set
correlation_id (random(16)) propagated through every typed function-call in a single request; stored in audit_log.correlation_id (the per-request timeline) — inherited from B1
Negative position: no PagerDuty / no OpsGenie (free-tier envelope; ≤ 5 staff + ≤ 50 orders/day does not justify an alerting service) — inherited from B1
Trunk-based dev (org.md); squash-merge to main with the Bolt slug as the commit message; no release branches (inherited from B1)

16 build stages (lint, tsc, prettier, bun test U1+U3, coverage ≥ 80 %, R1.1, R1.2 extended to U3 routes, R2.1, R2.2, R2.3, R2.4, R2.5, PCI deny-list extended, vite build, bundle-size assertion, mutation discipline) — every stage blocks the merge

Reverse-deploy gates (team.md §Dep-6): a regression in coverage, CI, or the recognition-basis / role-gate / audit-immutability / segment-isolation invariants blocks the merge — not just a failed unit test
Staging auto-deploys on merge to main (RTO ≤ 24 h); production deploys on manual approval (OC1 / single-decider) — inherited from B1

Rollback is re-deploy the previous artifact (vendor's free-tier keeps the last 5 deploys); code revert is reserved for the rare case where the prior artifact itself is the source of the failure — inherited from B1

No feature-flag service on the free-tier envelope; Bolt-by-Bolt deploys + the routes registry + the three-layer gate + audit-log reversals are the natural boundaries (inherited from B1); the 3 deferred input mode placeholders are isolated by the typed ParseResult shape
No Vault / no AWS Secrets Manager (free-tier envelope); env vars on the vendor's free-tier runtime are the binding mechanism for DATABASE_URL, SESSION_KEY, EMAIL_KEY — inherited from B1
Chrome binary path parameterised (NFR7.6, inherited from B1); Playwright 3G profile runs nightly (scheduled CI) for the 3 s p95 budget assertion on U1 + U3 primary screens

parse-success rate ≥ 95 % on the pilot corpus; R2.2 binding test
parseMessage never throws on bad input; typed ParseResult shape covers all error cases
Orders list ≤ 1 s for 1 000 orders; cursor-based pagination (page size 50, max 1 000)

Vite for the SPA build; vite build (CI); single bundle ≤ 350 KB gzip

shared_resources: postgres.js connection pool (max: 5) — U1 owns; U1 + U3 consume
audit_log table — U1 (L2 Audit) owns; U1 + U3 consume via appendAudit typed function-call
users / business / invitations / sessions tables — U1 (L1 Identity) owns; U1 only
Order / OrderItem / consignment_link tables — U3 (new in B2) owns; U3 writes; U2-catalog reads via typed surface (B3); U4-money reads via typed surface (B4)
customers / products / variants tables — U2-catalog (B3, future) owns; U3 reads via typed surface
Vendor's free-tier runtime — vendor owns; U1 + U3 deploy to the same runtime
Vendor's free-tier managed-DB — vendor owns; U1 + U3 share the DB
Vendor's free-tier email gateway — vendor owns; U1 (L1 Identity) consumes
Stdout collector (vendor's runtime) — vendor owns; U1 + U3 emit
Slow-query dashboard (vendor's managed-DB) — vendor owns; U1 + U3 read
Translation table (L(bn, en)) — U1 (L3 i18n) owns; U1 + U3 consume
Typed routes registry — U1 (L4 Router) owns; U1 + U3 add to at boot (U3 routes: paste-parse, manual, quick-add, repeat, order detail, status transition, deferred-input placeholders)
Typed state container — U1 (L5 State container) owns; U1 + U3 add slices to at boot (U3 slices: orders[], currentOrder, parseResult)
Noto Sans Bengali (woff2 subset) — U1 (L3 i18n, Shell primitive) owns; U1 + U3 import
Design tokens (CSS custom properties) — U1 owns; U1 + U3 consume

Q1.binding: U3 surfaces deploy to the same vendor's free-tier managed runtime as B1; no new infrastructure

Q2.binding: Single synchronous order hot path with typed appendAudit helper; NFR1.4 3 s p95 budget

Q3.binding: Pure-function parseMessage; 200-item cap enforced inside the function; micro-benchmark is the binding test

Q4.binding: In-process status-bucket math; per-page on 50 orders; typed state container is the cache

Q5.binding: Typed placeholders only; deferred_input_invoked log event is the impact-signal for a future Bolt

Q6.binding: Inherit B1's observability surface unchanged; no new dashboards; audit-log row IS the log line

Q7.binding: B2 R2.x gates added to the same CI pipeline; no new CI infrastructure
